title: Earn up to 10% Cashback as AliExpress Credit on Eligible Purchases (A$45 Cap Per Day, A$500 Total) @ AliExpress
body:
Deal: Earn up to 10% Cashback as AliExpress Credit on Eligible Purchases (A$45 Cap Per Day, A$500 Total) @ AliExpress

[tunzafun001] I'm getting
"Sorry, this offer is not available in your area"?
[Clear] If you're using a VPN that'll likely be the reason. You have to be in Australia for it to show. Alternatively no address has been added to your account.
[tunzafun001] Don't have a VPN..but just signed up to optus NBN for the first time ever.
Used mobile data and it worked.
So what does this mean, should I be speaking to Optus about it?
[Nivlac] Accidentally joined a different group 🤦🤦🤦
[bdl] "Ozbargain Lawn Mower and Whipper Snipper Club"
[beesa888] The same happened to me, even after clicking the link here on OZB, what the hell happened?
[Lister55] Me too 😭😭😭
"Sabrina" on 0 points… OzB is on 40!
[Clear] Someone once said clearing all the cookies for AliExpress fixes it but I haven't tested it.
[MeesusEff] That happened to me in July, ended up accidentally joining the Davis Fang group. No way to unjoin
[sssx] How big does the OzBargain team usually get? Does it reach the 10% cashback threshold? Would it be better to join a group with heaps of people already in it?
[Clear] Team OzBargain is always the largest team globally and often reaches 10%.
[bdl] I find I have to re-join every few sales, so I think the membership number varies over time?
[Clear] 2% is the base level. When everyone buys enough it will go up.
[poppingtags] Thanks Clear! How do I actually use the credit I earn again? Is it automatically added to cart if eligible?
Also bigger than the EOFY sale is wild! Hopefully we get a cashback to match!
[Clear] It shows up as a discount at checkout that you can choose to unselect or select X amount.
The AliExpress team are currently in Australia and they say it'll be better than EOFY so I'm hoping it to be wild :)
